component.name: Impasto
component.summary: Paint and draw with a pen tablet

description.p: Impasto is a painting app for pen tablets in the spirit of Procreate: a full-window canvas, brushes that respond to pressure and tilt, and tools that keep out of the way. It paints on the graphics card at 16 bits a channel.

ul.li: 115 brushes in 14 sets, and a Brush Lab to make your own
Layers with masks, groups, clipping and 26 blend modes
QuickShape: hold the pen at the end of a stroke for a clean line, curve or shape
Symmetry, perspective guides, selections, fills, gradients, text and liquify
Opens and saves Photoshop (PSD/PSB) and OpenRaster files
